name: Shao.Probability.iid_samplePath_identDistrib_perm
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ}
  [hμ : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [hν : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (X i)) →
    ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) id μ ν) →
        ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)),
          ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (Shao.Probability.samplePath X) (Shao.Probability.samplePath fun i => X (σ i))
            μ μ

name: Shao.Probability.iid_observable_identDistrib_perm
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ}
  [hμ : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [hν : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {β : Type u_2}
  [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace β] {X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (X i)) →
    ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) id μ ν) →
        ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) {F : Shao.Path n → β},
          Measurable F →
            ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (fun ω => F (Shao.Probability.samplePath X ω))
              (fun ω => F (Shao.Probability.samplePath (fun i => X (σ i)) ω)) μ μ

    ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) id μ ν) →
